Voice AI: A curated learning path for building real-time voice agents

name: Voice AI
summary: Curated learning path for building real-time voice AI agents, with 207 tagged resources across 21 sections.
description: A path from your first STT call to production telephony: foundations, frameworks (LiveKit Agents, Pipecat, Vapi), speech-to-text, text-to-speech, LLMs for voice, VAD and turn-taking, audio enhancement, WebRTC, SIP, tutorials, starter repos, datasets, benchmarks, ethics and production concerns. Resources are tagged beginner, intermediate or advanced, and a companion book condenses the path.
contains: sections for frameworks, STT, TTS, VAD, WebRTC, SIP, tutorials and datasets
